series.title: WIPE-OUT @ ECML-PKDD
series.text: Workshop on Innovations, Privacy-preservation, and Evaluations Of machine Unlearning Techniques. Focusing on selective data removal from AI models for privacy, bias mitigation, and regulatory compliance.

series.title: DELTA @ KDD
series.text: Workshop on Discovering Drift Phenomena in Evolving Data Landscapes at KDD 2024. Covering drift detection, data streams, and adaptive machine learning.

series.title: BIAS @ ECIR
series.text: International Workshop on Algorithmic Bias in Search and Recommendation, co-located with ECIR. Four successful editions addressing fairness, transparency, and social impacts of search and recommendation systems.

series.title: SoMePeAS / SoAPS @ ECIR
series.text: Workshops on Social Media for Personalization and Search, and Social Aspects in Personalization and Search. Three editions exploring social signals for improved personalization and information retrieval.

series.title: SIR @ CIKM
series.text: Workshop on Social Interaction-based Recommendation at CIKM 2018. Extending the classic notion of social recommendation by leveraging diverse social interaction data.

series.title: SERecSys @ ICDM
series.text: Workshop on Semantics-Enabled Recommender Systems. Two editions at ICDM exploring semantic knowledge to enrich recommendation processes.
